county-officials.summary: County board districts aren't built for this instance yet; the County card names your county but no members.
county-officials.why: This instance ships the layers a national publisher can answer. County board supervisory districts and rosters are a per-county build against each county's own published map and member list, and none has been built yet.
county-officials.wanted: Any county's official supervisory-district map (GIS layer, vector PDF, or certified election results naming whole wards) plus its board roster page — one county is enough to start.
